## Current candidate and separate equal-lifetime observation

The current Draft head is **`1ebb6208f2f5f8fe8a5bf237c00a3d963f44bb08`**, published by normal fast-forward on **2026-10-10 at 00:08:26–00:08:27 UTC**, against the unchanged fixed base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. The actual PR test merge is `c35120cfabcac9d83e7694dea96f4e3e8bed3973`; its complete tree equals the reviewed head tree `2f25902215490675396fbf114cb6029d7e7b8b8d`.

The retained-statement implementation remains unchanged. This three-commit P/R/G extension adds a separately named ignored diagnostic and exact-label workflow. It preserves the original test prefix, original cost workflow and original 80 cost observations.

The new diagnostic gives both sides the same live output scope: one common immutable typed-row reference, followed by each side's complete native base/FTS equality checks and result drop before the other timer starts. It retains all four cases × 20 alternating-order pairs. Timers retain the original boundaries: BEGIN is before timing; INSERT/compression work is inside; readback and rollback are after. Allocation/cache/order effects remain visible, with no new performance threshold or outlier trimming. The workflow also retains the actual Cargo-produced ELF bytes and their recorded hash, size and mode.

The original v15 source verifier actually exited 0 at 00:07:11 UTC, and the original task-plan check exited 0 at 00:07:12 UTC. All 1,439 selected input bytes/modes and the actual HEAD/index stayed unchanged. The reviewed domain is 1,096 product inputs / 72 original-BASE differences / 144 validation inputs. Earlier fetch, host preparation, generation and original-verifier environment failures are preserved; the missing historical Git objects were recovered before the successful original checks. [Complete admission outputs, unchanged-input records, preserved failures, independent G review and actual publication proof](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/b176f9a89d4a889d593987f7e90564561bb9ed73/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-pr191-equal-lifetime-admission-bfcc-20261010) are archived.

Root is now requesting one independently named bounded observation through the sole new `p8-rebuild-chunk-equal-lifetime-cost-run` label. It matches only the new observation job. The old cost label remains in place and is not toggled or retriggered. The source fast-forward separately starts ordinary new-head CI, including the repository's existing runtime/soak conditions. Neither new-source CI success nor a new performance result is claimed at this publication boundary.

**Default adoption remains on hold pending the new original results and their independent review.** This observation does not replace the original study, explain its ordering effects by itself, or establish full-build/100k performance. The fixed review branch retains its historical 163 done / 29 remaining task snapshot; current main separately has **164 done / 28 remaining**. This candidate and observation add **zero** original TODO completion credit.

## Purpose and behavior

Full rebuilds currently reacquire the same cached chunk INSERT statements for every row. This candidate retains the base-table and FTS statements for one rebuild-owned file, preparing each lazily when its first row reaches it.

The sequence remains source JSON / compression selection → base INSERT → last_insert_rowid → FTS INSERT for every chunk. Each execution clears bindings on success and failure; handles are released at the original file boundary or error. The ordinary public path, statement-cache capacity, transaction scope, SQLite pragmas and row values retain their original behavior. No chunk batching or FTS deferral is added.
